AgentEd — web build
===================

This is the browser build of AgentEd, taken from the pull request whose
number and commit are in the name of the zip you downloaded.

Check you are running the build you think you are
-------------------------------------------------

The zip is named AgentEd-web-<sha>, where <sha> is seven characters. The
same seven characters appear on the pull request page, and again inside
the application under the kebab menu (the three dots) -> About.

Three places, one value. If any of them disagree, this is not the build
under review, and whatever you find will be about something else. Most
reports of "the fix does not work" in this project have been a stale
download.

Opening index.html directly does not work
-----------------------------------------

It has to be served over http://localhost. Two reasons, both hard:

  - The browser refuses to load the application's modules over file://.
  - Image support needs a secure context, which localhost is and a plain
    file is not.

So use one of the two below. Neither needs an installation, a copy of
the repository, or npm.

Option 1 — the script in this folder (nothing to install)
---------------------------------------------------------

Right-click serve.ps1 and choose "Run with PowerShell". It picks a free
port, prints the address and opens your browser.

If Windows blocks it, open PowerShell in this folder and run:

    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\serve.ps1

Press Ctrl+C in that window to stop it.

Option 2 — Python, if you have it
----------------------------------

Open a terminal in this folder and run:

    python -m http.server 8123

Then open http://localhost:8123 yourself.

Which browser
-------------

Chrome or Edge. Image support on the web build depends on the browser's
File System Access API, which today means a Chromium browser
(REQUIREMENTS section 7). The desktop build depends on none of this.
